cost_first: Recompute current native minimum-ticket preentry cost from fresh saved BID/ASK/FX, both commissions and minima, PnL fee semantics,2bps each-side slippage and .10EUR/24h funding stress. Require planned native prior-M5 tail sqrt(3) + entry roundtrip costs <=2EUR and margin<=80; prior 15minute range scale must cover roundtrip cost. This is a feasibility hurdle, not predicted profit. Quote validity/conversion at fixed exit measured for support only, never entry selection.
economic_hypothesis: Repeated upward midpoint changes reached after shorter completed waits than downward changes may indicate faster upward quote-pressure propagation; market makers slow inventory/quote adjustment is the proposed source of compensation. Reverse for faster downward changes. Participant identities/order-flow and causality are not observed; random bid/ask bounce and adverse selection may dominate all costs.
economics: Native actual saved BID/ASK and signed FX quote conversion, current native4type precise commission and min floors both sides, current PnL conversion fee; scenarios(S0,F0),(S2,F.10),(S5,F.50) bps-per-side/EUR-day. Quote-native NET with current fee/slippage/funding scenarios is labelled reference/proxy; full historical actual NET remains N/A absent actual historical terms/fills. Midpoint gross, spread, slippage, commission, FX costs and funding decomposed, no unknown=zero.
entry: Fixed saved candidate t, score side, native minimum ticket; eligible current contract, preentry cost/risk/scale gates. No order/fill; historical reference at server as-of t with feature cutoff t-1s, actual latency unavailable.
exit: Fixed t+900seconds only; no dynamic stop rescue. Planned risk is tail/friction proxy, not guaranteed max adverse excursion; no intrahold complete tick path/stop fill claimed. If observed reference close loss breaches planned risk, ledger halts and reports failure.
falsification: Nonpositive primary model NET or paired increment versus either baseline, inconsistent block/half signs or planned/realized risk violation => no promotion of exact. Missing data => data-limited not predictor null; positive pilot => exploratory only, no alpha/HARD21 certification.
feature: 45 closed 1second states t-45..t-1 from raw BID/ASK pages t-60..t-1; change-price freshness5s both sides, changed-side skew2s, full pages hasMore false. Same-ms conflicting side price censors. First duration left-censored; ignore zero midpoint change; up/down each require2 completed durations. Score ln(mean_wait_down/mean_wait_up); sign gives side; 64ULP tie->cash. No coefficient fit, orientation/horizon grid or sign rescue.
inference: Prior adaptive source selection, cross-symbol shared clocks and serial dependence. Descriptive only no iid pvalue or independent confirmation; all current terms dated rather than historically known metadata. No universe economic closure.
information: Price-change direction marked completed elapsed times, observable before entry without DOM quantities, trade-flow inference, external factors, published historical financing or future labels.
portfolio: Continuous200EUR cash, min(2,.01equity) planned aggregate risk, min(80,.4equity) margin, max(120,.6equity) reserve; max1 position; lowest current entry cost then SID; no future quote selection; first selected unknown exit/FX or realized reference risk violation halts; no reset or replacements. Minimum-volume units never fractional.

If blocked review next distinct candidate instead of running predictor on absent economics.

stability: All source40 sampled complete ISO weeks,4 fixed10sampled-week blocks and2 chronological halves, per identity and missingness. Sparse periodic windows are not all opportunities.
